title: Dating
statementMd:
This story is happening in a town named BubbleLand. There are $*n*$ houses in BubbleLand. In each of these $*n*$ houses lives a boy or a girl. People there really love numbers and everyone has their favorite number $*f*$. That means that the boy or girl that lives in the $*i*$-th house has favorite number equal to $*f*_{*i*}$.

The houses are numerated with numbers $1$ to $*n*$.

The houses are connected with $*n* - 1$ bidirectional roads and you can travel from any house to any other house in the town. There is exactly one path between every pair of houses.

A new dating had agency opened their offices in this mysterious town and the citizens were very excited. They immediately sent $*q*$ questions to the agency and each question was of the following format:

- $*a* *b*$ — asking how many ways are there to choose a couple (boy and girl) that have the same favorite number and live in one of the houses on the unique path from house $*a*$ to house $*b*$.

Help the dating agency to answer the questions and grow their business.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of houses in the town.

The second line contains $*n*$ integers, where the $*i*$-th number is $1$ if a boy lives in the $*i*$-th house or $0$ if a girl lives in $*i*$-th house.

The third line contains $*n*$ integers, where the $*i*$-th number represents the favorite number $*f*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$) of the girl or boy that lives in the $*i*$-th house.

The next $*n* - 1$ lines contain information about the roads and the $*i*$-th line contains two integers $*a*_{*i*}$ and $*b*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$) which means that there exists road between those two houses. It is guaranteed that it's possible to reach any house from any other.

The following line contains an integer $*q*$ ($1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$), the number of queries.

Each of the following $*q*$ lines represents a question and consists of two integers $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*$).

## Output

For each of the $*q*$ questions output a single number, the answer to the citizens question.

## Note

In the first question from house $1$ to house $3$, the potential couples are $(1, 3)$ and $(6, 3)$.

In the second question from house $7$ to house $5$, the potential couples are $(7, 6)$, $(4, 2)$ and $(4, 5)$.
statementZhMd:
这个故事发生在一个名为 BubbleLand 的小镇。BubbleLand 中有 $*n*$ 所房屋。每所房屋中住着一个男孩或女孩。这里的人们非常喜欢数字，每个人都有自己最喜欢的数字 $*f*$。也就是说，第 $*i*$ 所房屋中居住的男孩或女孩最喜欢的数字是 $*f*_{*i*}$。

房屋的编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。

这些房屋由 $*n* - 1$ 条双向道路连接，你可以从小镇中的任意一所房屋前往其他任意房屋。每一对房屋之间恰好存在一条路径。

一家新的婚介机构在这个神秘的小镇开设了办事处，居民们对此非常兴奋。他们立即向婚介机构提出了 $*q*$ 个问题，每个问题的形式如下：

- $*a* *b*$ ——询问有多少种方法可以选择一对情侣（一个男孩和一个女孩），使他们拥有相同的最喜欢的数字，并且分别居住在从房屋 $*a*$ 到房屋 $*b*$ 的唯一路径上的某所房屋中。

请帮助婚介机构回答这些问题，拓展他们的业务。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示小镇中的房屋数量。

第二行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，其中第 $*i*$ 个数为 $1$，表示第 $*i*$ 所房屋中住着男孩；为 $0$，表示第 $*i*$ 所房屋中住着女孩。

第三行包含 $*n*$ 个整数，其中第 $*i*$ 个数表示居住在第 $*i*$ 所房屋中的女孩或男孩最喜欢的数字 $*f*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *f*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{9}$）。

接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行包含道路信息，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*a*_{*i*}$ 和 $*b*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*} ≤ *n*$），表示这两所房屋之间存在一条道路。保证任意一所房屋都可以到达其他任意房屋。

接下来一行包含一个整数 $*q*$（$1 ≤ *q* ≤ 10^{5}$），表示询问数量。

接下来的 $*q*$ 行中的每一行表示一个问题，包含两个整数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *a*, *b* ≤ *n*$）。

## 输出格式

对于每个问题，输出一个数字，表示居民问题的答案。

## 说明

在第一个问题中，从房屋 $1$ 到房屋 $3$，可能的情侣为 $(1, 3)$ 和 $(6, 3)$。

在第二个问题中，从房屋 $7$ 到房屋 $5$，可能的情侣为 $(7, 6)$、$(4, 2)$ 和 $(4, 5)$。
